caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of woven fabric with frayed edges, centered within a lightly outlined square on a plain, light beige background. The fabric has a checkered pattern composed of alternating squares in brown and pink, arranged in a grid. Each square is bordered by thin blue lines that form a grid across the entire fabric. The edges of the fabric show irregular, protruding fibers, emphasizing the woven texture. The composition focuses solely on the patterned fabric swatch, with no other objects or decorative elements present.
title: Homemade Cloth
